interpretation_contract.raw_values_control: Numeric parsing preserves literal syntax only and is not source/legal/scientific acceptance. Original source transcriptions control any discrepancy.
interpretation_contract.scalar_direction: An absent explicit operator is null, not an assumed maximum or minimum. A selected profile supplies an attributable operator/interpretation.
interpretation_contract.range_meaning: Two numbers separated by a dash are not automatically a permissible interval. Endpoint meaning and inclusivity remain unassigned.
interpretation_contract.chemical_identity: Original names/CAS/formulae may themselves be inconsistent. No automatic chemical repair, deduplication, unit-species conversion or cross-instrument mapping.
interpretation_contract.qualifications: All source notes remain in linked transcriptions. A lack of a row flag does not establish absence of qualifications.
interpretation_contract.grouping: No automatic grouping. Sanpin5,Sanpin22 and draftPaket35 remain distinct; Sanpin22 prose/formula equality discrepancy remains unresolved.
interpretation_contract.sizing: No conservative-solute applicability follows from a concentration limit.
run_profile_required: authorised or explicit scenario group rule/members/denominators
